description: The minimum this application needs: a window, a file picker for choosing a spreadsheet, and a save dialog for naming the exported order list. Both dialogs return a PATH and nothing more -- no filesystem permission is granted, so the frontend cannot read or write a file itself; the backend does both, at a path the user chose. No shell execution permission is granted either -- the backend is spawned directly by the Rust process at a path we computed, so there is no scope for a shell plugin to widen.
